subject: maths
question:
Study the given three-dimensional chart and answer the question that follows. The chart details the sale of fruits in different months.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e260d854a3bbbf60bdcc0e7bc116ee33e2772b5bf7322190b056720434c627e6.png] 

In which month was the sale of Melons the lowest and by how much was it more than the sale of Oranges in that month?
solution:
**Given:**

Sales data of various fruits in different months (as shown in the three-dimensional chart).

**Calculations:**

Melon sales in each month:

April: 33 units

May: 58 units

June: 20 units

The lowest sale of melons was in June: 20 units

Orange sales in June: 17 units

Difference between melon and orange sales in June:

⇒ 20 (melons) - 17 (oranges) = 3 units

**∴ The sale of melons was the lowest in June and it was 3 units more than the sale of oranges in that month.**
